body:
WHAT
The Agent tool hands a self-contained task to a fresh child session (a 'subagent') and returns that child's final message as the tool result. The child shares the working directory but starts with no memory of the conversation, gets a tool set filtered by its type (general-purpose, explore, plan), never receives the Agent tool itself, and its askUser hook throws. With run_in_background it returns a task id instead.

WHY
Without it the main agent cannot fan work out in parallel or keep large search output out of its own context, and without the restrictions a subagent could recurse forever or block waiting on a user who cannot see it.

WHERE
engine/tools/src/agent.ts — agentTool (parallelSafe:true, execute() calls ctx.session.spawnAgent(), offeredAgentTypes()/agentTypeList() fill the {{agentTypes}} description slot). engine/core/src/agent/agents.ts — AGENT_TYPES, READONLY_TOOLS, agentToolNames() (filters out 'Agent'), resolveAgentType(), SUBAGENT_RESULT_ID. engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.spawnAgent(): registry.subset(agentToolNames(...)), child Session with askUser that throws 'subagents cannot ask the user', MAX_CHILDREN check, background branch via this.background.launch(kind:'agent').

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a FakeProvider that returns a plain text answer, call agentTool.execute({description, prompt}) on a session and assert the result content equals the child's final assistant text and that agent_spawned/agent_finished events were emitted with the same agentId.
2. Spawn an 'explore' subagent with a FakeProvider that tries to call Write; assert the child's registry (registry.subset(agentToolNames(AGENT_TYPES.explore, all))) contains only Read, Glob, Grep, TaskList, TaskGet and the Write call is rejected as an unknown tool.
3. Assert agentToolNames(AGENT_TYPES['general-purpose'], allNames) never contains 'Agent', so a subagent whose FakeProvider emits an Agent tool_use gets an unknown-tool error rather than a grandchild session.
4. Have the child's FakeProvider emit an AskUserQuestion tool_use; assert the tool result is an error containing 'subagents cannot ask the user' and the parent's askUser hook was never invoked.
5. Call execute() with subagent_type 'nonexistent'; assert isError:true and the message lists the available types; call with run_in_background:true and assert the content contains 'task id: agent_' and the parent's background.get(id) exists.
